instructions.name: claim_milestone
docs: Pays a citizen their share. No signature from the citizen required —
the team pushes each payout to the recorded holder's ATA. Once per
milestone, only after finalize_milestone.
share = (fund_snapshot * payout_bps / 10000) * (weight / total_weight)

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever submits + pays the tx fee (on practice: owners). The citizen
does not sign — the payout is pushed to their recorded ATA.

instructions.name: claim_pool_fees
docs: Permissionless: pull the trading fee accrued on the pool position into the
treasury. The Config PDA owns the position NFT, so it signs the Meteora
`claim_position_fee` call itself; the destination is hard-wired to the
treasury account, so whoever calls this can only ever help the treasury.
Not pause-gated: it is an INFLOW, not a spend.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; only pays the transaction fee.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The ONLY place the fee can go.

instructions.name: claim_salary
docs: Claim salary for a role — once a day, a fixed % of the MORNING treasury
snapshot (not the live balance). Does not use up minister_spend's
daily/weekly limit — this is separate, guaranteed income for holding
the role. The "already paid today" record is kept per ROLE (0=president,
1=finance, 2=culture), not per wallet: handing the role to a new wallet
does not give the role a second salary the same day. `role` must be the
caller's own role.

instructions.name: close_proposal
docs: Clean-up: closes a finished proposal and returns its rent to whoever created it.
Anyone may call it (the money can only go back to the creator). Allowed once the
proposal was executed or has expired; a proposal whose voting was never opened
can be closed after ABANDONED_PROPOSAL_SECS.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone may clean up; the rent can only go back to the proposal's creator.

instructions.name: close_voter_snapshot
docs: Clean-up: closes a voter snapshot and returns its rent to the current owners_authority
(the account that paid for it). Anyone may call it. A snapshot is only needed until
voting ends, so it can be closed once the proposal's deadline has passed — or when the
proposal account no longer exists.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone may clean up; the rent can only go to the state's owners_authority.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: the handler reads it and only lets the snapshot go after the voting deadline.

instructions.name: create_milestone
docs: Owners declare a new milestone. The payout percentage locks in right
away (min(30% + 5%*(n-1), 50%)); the base is frozen later in
finalize_milestone.

instructions.name: create_proposal
docs: Create a proposal. Unlike voting, the creation threshold reads the
creator's LIVE balance against the voting base (supply - pool vault)
— deliberately fine, because creating a proposal doesn't execute
anything, it just opens a discussion. The voting clock does NOT start
here: the owner posts the snapshots, then calls `open_voting`.
proposal_type: 0=SPEND 1=ChangePresident 2=AppointFinance
3=AppointCulture 4=ChangeParam 5=ChangeOwnersAuthority
6=DepositToMilestoneFund

accounts.name: quorum_excluded
docs: The registered pool's governance-coin vault. Required once a pool is
registered (its balance is excluded from the voting base); omit before.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Executes a proposal. owners_authority only. Voting must have been opened and
its deadline passed, quorum (against the base frozen at `open_voting`) +
majority met, the timelock elapsed (for EVERY type, SPEND included), and the
proposal not expired (it stays executable for PROPOSAL_EXEC_WINDOW_SECS after
the timelock and the president's fallback delay). For SPEND — re-checks the
30% cap at execution time.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Recipient token account — required for SPEND (type 0). Owner is checked
against proposal.target inside execute_proposal. Omit for other types.

accounts.name: milestone_fund
docs: The Milestone Fund — required for DEPOSIT_TO_MILESTONE_FUND (type 6).

instructions.name: finalize_milestone
docs: Freezes the payout base and reserves the pool so a later milestone
cannot promise the same coins. Base = milestone_fund balance minus
what earlier milestones still owe (config.milestone_reserved).

accounts.name: previous_milestone
docs: Required when finalizing milestone 2+. Must be the immediately
previous record. Omit for milestone 1.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Sets up Config + treasury (an ATA of treasury_mint, owned by the Config PDA).
governance_mint = the voting coin, treasury_mint = the asset the pool pays
its fee in (wSOL / USDC / USDT). `token_program` is the treasury asset's program.
`owners_authority` (the owner's key) posts vote snapshots and
executes proposals. `admin_authority` (a separate key/multisig) can pause
treasury outflows and tune the citizenship threshold. The payer signs and
pays rent but gets no standing power. Ministers start vacant.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program of the treasury asset.

instructions.name: minister_spend
docs: Autonomous minister spend (finance/culture) — WITHOUT a vote, within
rolling limits as a % of the MORNING treasury snapshot. Limits are
tracked per ROLE (role 1 = finance, 2 = culture), so swapping the
minister's wallet does not reset the window. `reason` is required
(not checked for relevance — that restriction is reputational).

instructions.name: open_voting
docs: owners_authority closes the enrolment and starts the voting clock: from now on votes
are accepted and no snapshot can be added (so the first voter can no longer shut the
others out). Also freezes the voting base — supply minus the registered pool vault's
balance at this very moment — that the quorum will be measured against, so trades,
liquidity moves in the pool or a supply change cannot move it later. Needs at least
one snapshot; the sum of all weights cannot exceed the supply. The pool vault must be
passed once a pool is registered.

accounts.name: quorum_excluded
docs: The registered pool's governance-coin vault (required once a pool is registered):
its balance is left out of the voting base that gets frozen here.

instructions.name: post_milestone_snapshot
docs: Manual "citizen" snapshot for a milestone. The weight comes from the owner's ONE
scan of the holders (see post_voter_snapshot): it must be positive, not more than
the holder's balance right now, and >= citizenship_threshold_bps of supply.

accounts.name: holder_token_account
docs: The holder's real token account — the posted weight cannot exceed its balance.

instructions.name: post_voter_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of one voter's weight for a proposal — owners_authority only, and only
BEFORE `open_voting`. The owner takes ONE consistent scan of the holders' balances
and posts the weights from it; the program checks that the weight is positive and
that the voter still holds at least that much right now. So coins moved to another
wallet after the scan can't be counted a second time: the other wallet's weight is
whatever it held at scan time. Created once (`init`): the weight cannot be rewritten
and `consumed` cannot be cleared.

accounts.name: voter_token_account
docs: The voter's real token account — the posted weight cannot exceed its balance.

instructions.name: register_pool
docs: One-time (owners_authority): link the Meteora DAMM v2 pool whose trading
fee feeds the treasury. The pool must be governance_mint (token A) /
treasury_mint (token B) in "fee only in B" mode, and the Config PDA must
already hold the position NFT. Also fixes the pool's token-A vault as the
account excluded from the voting base. Cannot be changed afterwards.

accounts.name: pool
docs: verified from its raw data inside register_pool.

accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: The token account holding the position NFT; its authority must be the Config PDA.

accounts.name: fee_a_account
docs: Governance-coin account owned by the Config PDA: the (normally empty)
"token A" destination Meteora's claim instruction insists on.

instructions.name: release_milestone_reserve
docs: Closes a milestone after the claim grace period: whatever was promised
but not paid out returns to the fund's free balance (the reserve is
released), so the next milestone can use it. Claims on a closed
milestone are no longer possible. owners_authority only.

instructions.name: set_citizenship_threshold
docs: admin_authority tunes the "who counts as a citizen" threshold.
Kept off the voting path deliberately (see project notes).

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: admin_authority flips the global pause on all treasury/fund outflows.
Meant as a break-glass while a bug is being patched.

instructions.name: setup_milestone_fund
docs: One-time: create the Milestone Fund token account (PDA) and record its
address in Config. Call after `initialize` if milestones will be used.

instructions.name: vote
docs: Holders vote themselves, each with their own transaction — weight comes
from the snapshot (VoterSnapshot), which must already exist. Votes are
accepted only after the owner has called `open_voting`, and until the deadline.

errors.name: ParamOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Parameter value out of allowed bounds

errors.name: VotingAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: Voting is already open: no more snapshots can be added

errors.name: VotingNotOpen
errors.msg: Voting has not been opened yet (the owner must call open_voting after posting snapshots)

errors.name: WeightExceedsBalance
errors.msg: Snapshot weight is more than the voter's current balance

errors.name: NoSnapshots
errors.msg: No snapshots were posted for this proposal

errors.name: SnapshotWeightExceedsSupply
errors.msg: The sum of the posted weights exceeds the coin supply

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.msg: This approved proposal has expired and can no longer be executed

errors.name: NotFinishedYet
errors.msg: Not finished yet: nothing to clean up

errors.name: SpendCooldown
errors.msg: Another spend was executed too recently (spend cooldown)

errors.name: NotEligibleForPayroll
errors.msg: Signer is not eligible for payroll (not president/minister)

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing to claim (bps is 0 or balance empty)

errors.name: NotYourSnapshot
errors.msg: This snapshot does not belong to you

errors.name: SnapshotAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Snapshot token account does not match the voter/holder or mint

errors.name: RoleConflict
errors.msg: A role must be held by a distinct address

errors.name: NotMinister
errors.msg: Signer is not finance or culture minister

errors.name: WrongRecipient
errors.msg: Recipient does not match the approved proposal target

errors.name: MilestoneFundMissing
errors.msg: Milestone fund account missing or mismatched

errors.name: PreviousMilestoneNotFinalized
errors.msg: Previous milestone is missing or not yet finalized

errors.name: MilestoneClosed
errors.msg: Milestone is closed (unclaimed part already returned to the fund)

errors.name: MilestoneGraceNotElapsed
errors.msg: Claim grace period has not elapsed yet

errors.name: PoolNotRegistered
errors.msg: Fee pool is not registered yet

errors.name: PoolMismatch
errors.msg: Pool is not the governance/treasury pair in fee-only-B mode

errors.name: PositionMismatch
errors.msg: Position does not belong to this pool or the Config PDA does not hold it

errors.name: ExcludedAccountMissing
errors.msg: The registered pool vault must be passed to compute the voting base

fields.name: governance_mint
docs: The state's own voting coin (no transfer tax).

fields.name: treasury_mint
docs: The asset the treasury holds (the pool's quote asset: wSOL / USDC / USDT).

fields.name: fee_pool
docs: Meteora pool / position / position-NFT account that feed the treasury (zero until register_pool).

fields.name: quorum_excluded_account
docs: Governance-coin account (the pool vault) excluded from the voting base; zero until register_pool.

fields.name: proposal_type
docs: 0=Spend 1=ChangePresident 2=AppointFinance 3=AppointCulture
4=ChangeParam 5=ChangeOwnersAuthority 6=DepositToMilestoneFund

fields.name: deadline
docs: 0 until `open_voting`; then (opening time + voting_period_secs).

fields.name: voting_open
docs: False while the owner is still posting snapshots; true once `open_voting` was called.

fields.name: total_snapshot_weight
docs: Running sum of every snapshot weight posted (checked against the supply at open_voting).

fields.name: base_at_open
docs: The voting base frozen at `open_voting`: supply minus the pool vault balance at that moment.
